title: Library, empty
summary: Dana's Library before she owns anything: the display h1, who she is signed in as, one empty state with the star, one sentence, Activate a license as the primary and See 2 in Discover, and the Missing a license? strip kept.
compare: Owner decisions (2026-10-20, PX-35) supersede the lines below where they differ; the HTML redraw is a follow-up. The header has no Activate license button, so this state's own Activate license is the one ink primary (it no longer repeats the header's label); the account menu's first item opens the same modal. No footer; 'Missing a license?' is the sticky strip.
One empty state: the Polaris star, one line of what will show here, Activate a license (the one primary) and 'See 2 in Discover' (outlined, with the count of products she can add) (portal-17).
The Missing a license? strip is at the page's foot, above the footer (the owner, 2026-10-09); the empty state takes the room between the title and it, its content centred.
The subtitle says who is signed in, once; no count of zero products.
The display h1 (48/52, 32/36 on a phone); the bottom bar's Library is selected on a phone.
Round 2 (UX review): One name for the action ('Activate license', as the header); no count on the Library tab when it is zero.
